process.title: Drawings or brief
process.text: Send your design team's drawings, or tell us about the unit and what it needs to do.

process.title: Site visit
process.text: Alex visits the unit and discusses trading, access and timing constraints.

process.title: Design or pricing
process.text: We price your drawings, or develop the fit-out design with you.

process.title: Detailed written quotation
process.text: You receive a written quotation for the fit-out.

process.title: Build and handover
process.text: We build the fit-out, working with your certifiers, and hand over the unit.

faqs.q: Can you work around our trading hours?
faqs.a: We plan the work around your business. At BAH33 we installed a new porcelain floor over the Christmas closure.

faqs.q: Do you work with our design team?
faqs.a: Yes. At BAH33 we worked with the design team, Assigned Certifier and fire engineer.
Yes. We designed the reception, waiting areas and joinery for a Dublin 1 clinic, and the bar and washrooms at BAH33. Design is a paid service with a fixed fee quoted after the first meeting.

faqs.q: Do you provide fire safety certificates or act as Assigned Certifier?
faqs.a: No. Fire engineering, fire safety certificates and the Assigned Certifier role are handled by registered external professionals. We work alongside them.
Yes. Commercial joinery such as reception desks is made in our Drumree workshop and fitted by our joiners.

cta.title: Fitting out a unit?
cta.text: Send us your drawings, or tell us about the unit. Alex will arrange a visit.

sections.title: Two ways to start
paragraphs: Already have drawings? We price and build from your architect's or designer's drawings and work with your design team.

Need design help? We develop layouts, interiors, 3D visualisation, planning and design drawings and the construction concept, bringing in the appropriate architect, engineer or other professional where specialist engineering, certification or regulated services are required, and can then build it.

sections.title: Certification and fire safety
paragraphs: Fit-outs often need fire safety certificates, an Assigned Certifier and fire engineering. These are provided by registered external professionals, not under our name. We work alongside them, as we did at BAH33.
